page_title: How to Build a Delightful Loading Screen in 5 Minutes

summary.title: How to Build a Delightful Loading Screen in 5 Minutes
summary.one_liner: You learn to build a Slack-style spinning loader and centered loading message using only HTML and CSS (flexbox, half-colored borders, border-radius, and keyframe rotation).
keywords: how to make a spinner in css
takeaways: Center a page's content vertically and horizontally with display flex on the body, justify-content and align-items center.
Make a spinner by giving a span inline-block dimensions and a border, then coloring two sides differently.
Use border-radius 50% to turn a box element into a circle.
Animate rotation with @keyframes rotate to 1turn and apply animation with 600ms infinite linear.
summary.summary: This Medium tutorial by Emmanuel Ohans walks through recreating the Slack loading screen with plain HTML and CSS, with a linked CodePen demo. It starts with a simple section and span markup, then centers the content using flexbox on the body. Next it styles the loading text and author line, and builds the spinner step by step: sizing, inline-block display, a grey border, two blue border sides, a circular border-radius, and a keyframe rotation. The article is short and beginner-friendly, with no JavaScript involved.
